<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="iNgwenya Consulting helps small and growing organisations build practical Quality Management Systems, strengthen documentation and prepare for ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025 audits.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="iNgwenya Consulting">
<meta property="og:description" content="iNgwenya Consulting helps small and growing organisations build practical Quality Management Systems, strengthen documentation and prepare for ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025 audits.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1F3949">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='6' fill='%231F3949'/%3E%3Cpath d='M12 6h8M13.500 6v8L7.500 25a2 2 0 0 0 1.800 3h13.400a2 2 0 0 0 1.800-3L18.500 14V6' fill='none' stroke='%23fff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/%3E%3Cpath d='M10 21h12' stroke='%235CBBC8' stroke-width='2.500'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<title>iNgwenya Consulting</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: left-aligned editorial page. A controlled-document header sits beside the hero thesis; services, process and standards follow as ruled, document-style sections. */
/* Palette taken from the iNgwenya logo: deep navy for ink and actions, teal for marks and references. */
:root {
  --bg: #ECEAE4;
  --surface: #F8F7F3;
  --ink: #1F3949;
  --muted: #4C6270;
  --line: #CFCDC5;
  --accent: #1F3949;
  --on-accent: #F4F6F6;
  --teal: #237382;
  --logo-a: #1F3949;
  --logo-b: #358B97;
  --font-display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace;
  --mask-a: url("data:image/png;base64,");
  --mask-b: url("data:image/png;base64,");
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #0C1A22; --surface: #12252F; --ink: #E4EEF0; --muted: #94AAB2; --line: #25404C;
    --accent: #5CBBC8; --on-accent: #08202A; --teal: #5CBBC8; --logo-a: #E4EEF0; --logo-b: #5CBBC8;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0C1A22; --surface: #12252F; --ink: #E4EEF0; --muted: #94AAB2; --line: #25404C;
  --accent: #5CBBC8; --on-accent: #08202A; --teal: #5CBBC8; --logo-a: #E4EEF0; --logo-b: #5CBBC8;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding-inline: 20px;
  padding-block: 0;
}
a { color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }
.wrap { max-width: 1120px; margin-inline: auto; }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

/* Header */
.top {
  position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 10;
  margin-inline: -20px; padding-inline: 20px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.top .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 64px; }
.brand { display: block; text-decoration: none; }
.logo { position: relative; display: block; height: 42px; aspect-ratio: 597 / 158; }
.logo span { position: absolute; inset: 0; -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat; mask-repeat: no-repeat; -webkit-mask-size: contain; mask-size: contain; -webkit-mask-position: left center; mask-position: left center; }
.logo .la { background: var(--logo-a); -webkit-mask-image: var(--mask-a); mask-image: var(--mask-a); }
.logo .lb { background: var(--logo-b); -webkit-mask-image: var(--mask-b); mask-image: var(--mask-b); }
.logo.sm { height: 34px; }
.nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
.nav a { text-decoration: none; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.btn {
  display: inline-block; text-decoration: none;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px;
  padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--accent);
}
.btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
.nav .btn { color: var(--on-accent); padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .nav a:not(.btn) { display: none; }
}

/* Hero */
.hero { padding-block: 56px 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 48px; align-items: start; }
.hero h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 6vw, 68px); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 18px 0 22px; text-wrap: balance;
}
.hero p.lead { font-size: 18px; max-width: 54ch; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 30px; }
.hero .actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }

.doc {
  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px;
  position: relative;
}
.doc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.doc dl { margin: 0; }
.doc .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.doc .row:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }
.doc dt { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 2px; }
.doc dd { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
  .hero { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 36px; padding-block: 40px 48px; }
}

/* Sections */
section { padding-block: 64px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sec-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); gap: 32px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
.sec-head h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 10px 0 0; text-wrap: balance; }
.sec-head p { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 58ch; align-self: end; }
@media (max-width: 880px) { .sec-head { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; } }

/* Services */
.services { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
.svc { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 26px 24px 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.svc h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
.svc .lede { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15.5px; }
.svc ul { list-style: none; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.svc li { padding: 10px 0 10px 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; position: relative; }
.svc li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 19px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }
.svc .pdca { width: 92px; height: 92px; flex: none; }
.svc-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 92px; }
.svc-code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; }
.glyph { width: 56px; height: 56px; color: var(--accent); flex: none; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .services { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .svc-top { min-height: 0; } }

/* Process */
.steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; counter-reset: step; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); }
.steps li { padding: 22px 20px 26px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.steps li:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.steps .n { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--teal); }
.steps h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.steps p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .steps { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .steps li { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 14px; }
  .steps li:first-child { border-top: 0; }
  .steps li p { flex-basis: 100%; }
}

/* Standards register */
.register { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); }
.reg-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); align-items: baseline; }
.reg-row:first-child { border-top: 0; }
.reg-row.head { background: transparent; padding-block: 11px; }
.reg-row.head span { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.reg-row .code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; color: var(--teal); font-size: 14.5px; }
.reg-row .what { font-weight: 500; }
.reg-row .how { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .reg-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px; }
  .reg-row.head { display: none; }
}

/* About */
.about { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); gap: 32px; }
.about h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 10px 0 0; }
.about .body p { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 17px; max-width: 62ch; }
.about .body p.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.principles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-top: 28px; }
.principles div { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); padding-top: 12px; }
.principles h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 19px; }
.principles p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 880px) { .about { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .principles { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

/* Contact */
.contact { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-radius: 3px; padding: 44px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 32px; align-items: end; }
.contact h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(28px, 4.2vw, 44px); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 14px; text-wrap: balance; }
.contact p { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; max-width: 52ch; opacity: 0.92; }
.contact .eyebrow { color: var(--on-accent); opacity: 0.8; display: block; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.reach { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.reach .line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 16px; }
.reach .label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; min-width: 82px; }
.reach .value { overflow-wrap: anywhere; user-select: all; }
.reach a.value { color: var(--on-accent); text-underline-offset: 3px; user-select: auto; }
.copy { background: transparent; color: var(--on-accent); border: 1px solid var(--on-accent); border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.copy:hover { background: var(--on-accent); color: var(--accent); }
@media (max-width: 880px) { .contact { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 32px 22px; } }

footer { padding-block: 32px 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin-top: 64px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
footer .mono { color: var(--muted); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }

/* Who we work with */
.who { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px; }
.who div { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); padding-top: 14px; }
.who h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.who p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 980px) { .who { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .who { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.svc.feature { border-color: var(--teal); }

.note { margin: 20px 0 0; max-width: 62ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }

/* Health check */
.hc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.5fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
.hc h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 10px 0 16px; text-wrap: balance; }
.hc .intro p { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 46ch; }
.hc .intro ul { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; }
.hc .intro li { padding: 9px 0 9px 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; position: relative; }
.hc .intro li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 18px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); }
.hc-form { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 26px 24px 28px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.hc-form .two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.field label, .q legend { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.field .opt { font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.field input, .field select, .field textarea {
  font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0;
}
.field textarea { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; }
.field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent); }
.q { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.q legend { padding: 0; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.opts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.opts label { cursor: pointer; }
.opts input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.opts span { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg); font-size: 14.5px; }
.opts input:checked + span { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.opts input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.hc-form h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 18px; margin: 6px 0 -4px; }
.hc-form .fine { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.hc-form button.btn { cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; justify-self: start; }
.hc-result { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: 8px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 3px; padding: 24px; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.hc-result h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; margin: 0; }
.hc-result p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
.hc-result textarea { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 260px; resize: vertical; }
.hc-result .acts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.hc-result button.btn { cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; }
@media (max-width: 880px) { .hc { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 28px; } }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .hc-form .two { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .hc-form { padding: 20px 16px 22px; } }

.btn.light { background: transparent; color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--on-accent); }
.contact .acts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }

/* Page reset (the claude.ai viewer supplied this; a standalone page needs it) */
:root { color-scheme: light; }
body { margin: 0; }
img { max-width: 100%; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="iNgwenya Consulting, back to top"><span class="logo" role="img" aria-label="iNgwenya Consulting logo"><span class="la"></span><span class="lb"></span></span></a>
    <nav class="nav" aria-label="Main">
      <a href="#services">Services</a>
      <a href="#approach">Approach</a>
      <a href="#standards">Standards</a>
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a class="btn" href="#health-check">Health Check</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top" class="wrap">

  <div class="hero">
    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">Quality Management Systems &middot; Laboratory Quality &middot; Compliance</span>
      <h1>Quality systems that stand up to audit &mdash; and work in practice.</h1>
      <p class="lead">iNgwenya Consulting helps small and growing organisations build practical Quality Management Systems, strengthen documentation, prepare for audits and turn quality requirements into processes their teams can actually use.</p>
      <div class="actions">
        <a class="btn" href="#contact">Start a Conversation</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#services">Explore Our Services</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <aside class="doc" aria-label="About iNgwenya Consulting">
      <div class="doc-head">
        <span class="mono">iNgwenya Consulting</span>
        <span class="mono">Established 2026 &middot; South Africa</span>
      </div>
      <dl>
        <div class="row"><dt>Scope</dt><dd>Practical QMS, laboratory quality and compliance support for small and growing organisations.</dd></div>
        <div class="row"><dt>Standards</dt><dd>ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025</dd></div>
        <div class="row"><dt>Focus</dt><dd>Quality Management Systems &middot; Laboratory Quality &middot; Compliance</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <section id="services">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">Services</span>
        <h2>What We Do</h2>
      </div>
      <p>Practical quality support for organisations that need their systems to work, not just exist.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="services">
      <article class="svc">
        <div class="svc-top">
          <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 56 56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="9" y="6" width="38" height="44" rx="2"/>
            <path d="M17 18h22M17 27h22M17 36h12"/>
            <path d="m33 40 4 4 8-9" stroke="var(--teal)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          </svg>
          <span class="svc-code">ISO 9001</span>
        </div>
        <h3>Quality Management Systems</h3>
        <p class="lede">Build and improve practical QMS processes aligned with applicable standards and organisational needs.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Design and implementation of ISO 9001-aligned quality management systems</li>
          <li>Process mapping, procedures, work instructions and document control</li>
          <li>Internal audit programmes and management review</li>
          <li>Preparation for certification and surveillance audits</li>
        </ul>
      </article>

      <article class="svc feature">
        <div class="svc-top">
          <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 56 56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M22 6h12M24 6v16L10.5 44a4 4 0 0 0 3.5 6h28a4 4 0 0 0 3.5-6L32 22V6"/>
            <path d="M17 36h22" stroke="var(--teal)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          </svg>
          <span class="svc-code">ISO/IEC 17025</span>
        </div>
        <h3>Laboratory Quality</h3>
        <p class="lede">Support laboratories with documentation, internal audits, quality records and ISO/IEC 17025 readiness.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>QMS gap assessments</li>
          <li>Documentation and SOP support</li>
          <li>Internal audit preparation</li>
          <li>Non-conformance and CAPA</li>
          <li>Document and record control</li>
          <li>Audit readiness</li>
        </ul>
      </article>

      <article class="svc">
        <div class="svc-top">
          <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 56 56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M28 5 47 12v15c0 12-8 19-19 24C17 46 9 39 9 27V12z" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <path d="m19 28 7 7 12-14" stroke="var(--teal)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          </svg>
          <span class="svc-code">Audit</span>
        </div>
        <h3>Compliance &amp; Audit Readiness</h3>
        <p class="lede">Identify gaps, organise evidence and support corrective action before an audit finds the problem.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Gap assessments against standards and customer requirements</li>
          <li>Audit evidence organised and ready to show</li>
          <li>Corrective actions tracked through to closure</li>
          <li>Independent review before an internal, customer or certification audit</li>
        </ul>
      </article>

      <article class="svc">
        <div class="svc-top">
          <svg class="pdca" viewBox="0 0 120 120" role="img" aria-label="Plan, Do, Check, Act cycle">
            <g fill="none" stroke="var(--teal)" stroke-width="9">
              <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="22.5 2.5" transform="rotate(180 60 60)"/>
              <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="22.5 2.5" transform="rotate(270 60 60)" opacity="0.82"/>
              <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="22.5 2.5" transform="rotate(0 60 60)" opacity="0.64"/>
              <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="22.5 2.5" transform="rotate(90 60 60)" opacity="0.46"/>
            </g>
            <g font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="var(--ink)" text-anchor="middle">
              <text x="43" y="48">P</text>
              <text x="77" y="48">D</text>
              <text x="77" y="78">C</text>

            </g>
          </svg>
          <span class="svc-code">PDCA</span>
        </div>
        <h3>Continuous Improvement</h3>
        <p class="lede">Use data, root-cause analysis and corrective action to turn recurring problems into measurable improvement.</p>

  <section id="who" style="padding-top: 56px;">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">Who we help</span>
        <h2>Who we work with</h2>
      </div>
      <p>We focus on organisations that need practical quality support without the overhead of a large consultancy.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="who">
      <div><h3>Small &amp; Growing Businesses</h3><p>Organisations developing their first formal quality system.</p></div>
      <div><h3>Laboratories &amp; Testing Facilities</h3><p>Organisations working towards stronger laboratory quality and ISO/IEC 17025 readiness.</p></div>
      <div><h3>Technical &amp; Manufacturing Organisations</h3><p>Businesses looking to strengthen processes, documentation and operational quality.</p></div>
      <div><h3>Organisations Preparing for Audits</h3><p>Businesses that need an independent review before an internal, customer or certification audit.</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="approach">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">How we work</span>
        <h2>Five steps, in this order.</h2>
      </div>
      <p>Every engagement follows the same path. Each step ends with a record you can show an auditor and a decision you can explain to your team.</p>
    </div>

    <ol class="steps">
      <li><span class="n">STEP 1</span><h3>Assess</h3><p>Observe how work is done today and compare it to the requirement.</p></li>
      <li><span class="n">STEP 2</span><h3>Design</h3><p>Build the simplest system that meets the standard and suits your operation.</p></li>
      <li><span class="n">STEP 3</span><h3>Implement</h3><p>Train people, roll out procedures and records, and keep daily work moving.</p></li>
      <li><span class="n">STEP 4</span><h3>Verify</h3><p>Audit internally, review the results and close every finding.</p></li>
      <li><span class="n">STEP 5</span><h3>Sustain</h3><p>Set measures, hold regular reviews and improve on the evidence.</p></li>
    </ol>
  </section>

  <section id="standards">
    <div class="sec-head">

        <span class="eyebrow">Standards</span>

      </div>

  <section id="about">
    <div class="about">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">About</span>
        <h2>Why iNgwenya.</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="body">
        <p>iNgwenya is derived from the isiZulu word <em>ingwenya</em>, meaning crocodile. It reflects the qualities we aim to bring to every system we build: patience, precision and durability.</p>
        <p class="muted">iNgwenya Consulting was established in 2026 to help small and growing organisations treat quality as part of everyday work. We write procedures people can follow, keep records light enough to maintain, and focus on evidence so problems are found before an audit finds them.</p>
        <div class="principles">
          <div><h3>Practical</h3><p>Documents and controls sized to your operation, not copied from a template.</p></div>
          <div><h3>Evidence-led</h3><p>Decisions rest on data, audit results and root causes.</p></div>

  <section id="health-check">
    <div class="hc">
      <div class="intro">
        <span class="eyebrow">Start here</span>
        <h2>Request a QMS Health Check</h2>
        <p>Tell us about your organisation and answer a few questions about how your quality system works today. We review your situation and follow up with the best next step.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Takes about five minutes</li>
          <li>Covers documentation, records, audits and corrective action</li>
          <li>Suits laboratories, technical organisations and small businesses</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <form class="hc-form" id="hc-form">
        <div class="two">
          <div class="field"><label for="hc-company">Company name</label><input id="hc-company" name="company" type="text" autocomplete="organization" required></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="hc-name">Your name</label><input id="hc-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required></div>
        </div>
        <div class="two">
          <div class="field"><label for="hc-email">Email</label><input id="hc-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="hc-phone">Phone <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label><input id="hc-phone" name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="two">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="hc-type">Type of organisation</label>
            <select id="hc-type" name="type" required>
              <option value="" selected disabled>Select one</option>
              <option>Laboratory or testing facility</option>
              <option>Technical or manufacturing organisation</option>
              <option>Small or growing business</option>
              <option>Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="hc-size">Size</label>
            <select id="hc-size" name="size" required>
              <option value="" selected disabled>Select one</option>
              <option>1&ndash;10 people</option>
              <option>11&ndash;50 people</option>
              <option>51&ndash;200 people</option>
              <option>More than 200 people</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="hc-situation">Where are you today?</label>
          <select id="hc-situation" name="situation" required>
            <option value="" selected disabled>Select one</option>
            <option>No formal quality system yet</option>
            <option>A quality system exists but needs improving</option>
            <option>Working towards ISO 9001 certification</option>
            <option>Working towards ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation</option>
            <option>Preparing for an audit</option>
            <option>Not sure</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field"><label for="hc-audit">Upcoming audit or deadline <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label><input id="hc-audit" name="audit" type="text" placeholder="For example: customer audit in March"></div>

        <h3>Your quality system today</h3>

        <fieldset class="q"><legend>Are your key processes documented in procedures or work instructions?</legend>
          <div class="opts">
            <label><input type="radio" id="q1-yes" name="q1" value="Yes" required><span>Yes</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q1-partly" name="q1" value="Partly"><span>Partly</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q1-no" name="q1" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q1-unsure" name="q1" value="Not sure"><span>Not sure</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset class="q"><legend>Are documents and records controlled (versions, approvals, retention)?</legend>
          <div class="opts">
            <label><input type="radio" id="q2-yes" name="q2" value="Yes" required><span>Yes</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q2-partly" name="q2" value="Partly"><span>Partly</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q2-no" name="q2" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q2-unsure" name="q2" value="Not sure"><span>Not sure</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset class="q"><legend>Have you carried out an internal audit in the last 12 months?</legend>
          <div class="opts">
            <label><input type="radio" id="q3-yes" name="q3" value="Yes" required><span>Yes</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q3-partly" name="q3" value="Partly"><span>Partly</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q3-no" name="q3" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q3-unsure" name="q3" value="Not sure"><span>Not sure</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset class="q"><legend>Are non-conformances and corrective actions recorded and followed up?</legend>
          <div class="opts">
            <label><input type="radio" id="q4-yes" name="q4" value="Yes" required><span>Yes</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q4-partly" name="q4" value="Partly"><span>Partly</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q4-no" name="q4" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" id="q4-unsure" name="q4" value="Not sure"><span>Not sure</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <div class="field"><label for="hc-challenge">What is your biggest quality challenge right now? <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label><textarea id="hc-challenge" name="challenge"></textarea></div>

        <button class="btn" type="submit">Prepare my request</button>
        <p class="fine">This page does not send your answers. The next step gives you a summary to email to iNgwenya Consulting.</p>
      </form>

      <div class="hc-result" id="hc-result" hidden>
        <h3>Your request is ready to send</h3>
        <p>Nothing has been sent yet. Copy the summary and email it to <strong>ingwenyaconsultancy@gmail.com</strong>, or open it in your email app.</p>
        <textarea id="hc-summary" readonly aria-label="Health Check request summary"></textarea>
        <div class="acts">
          <button class="btn" type="button" id="hc-copy">Copy summary</button>
          <a class="btn ghost" id="hc-mail" href="#">Open in email app</a>
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="hc-edit">Edit answers</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="contact" style="border-top:0; padding-block: 24px 0;">
    <div class="contact">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">Contact</span>
        <h2>Start a conversation.</h2>
        <p>Tell us which standard you are working towards, which audit is coming up, or which process keeps causing problems. We will tell you how we would approach it.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="reach">
        <div class="line"><span class="label">Email</span><span class="value">ingwenyaconsultancy@gmail.com</span><button type="button" class="copy" data-copy="ingwenyaconsultancy@gmail.com">Copy</button></div>
        <div class="line"><span class="label">LinkedIn</span><a class="value" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ingwenyaconsulting/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">iNgwenya Consulting on LinkedIn</a></div>
        <div class="acts"><a class="btn light" href="#health-check">Request a QMS Health Check</a></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap"><span class="logo sm" role="img" aria-label="iNgwenya Consulting logo"><span class="la"></span><span class="lb"></span></span><span>&copy; 2026 iNgwenya Consulting. All rights reserved.</span></span>
    <span class="mono"><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ingwenyaconsulting/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a> &middot; Established 2026 &middot; South Africa</span>
  </footer>
</main>

<script>
(function () {
  var EMAIL = "ingwenyaconsultancy@gmail.com";

  function selectText(node) {
    try { node.focus(); node.select(); } catch (e) {
      var r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(node);
      var s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);
    }
  }
  function copyFrom(btn, text, fallbackNode) {
    var label = btn.textContent;
    function done() { btn.textContent = "Copied"; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = label; }, 1600); }
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, function () { selectText(fallbackNode); });
    } catch (e) { selectText(fallbackNode); }
  }

  // Copy buttons next to a value (contact block)
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-copy]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var v = b.parentNode.querySelector(".value");
      copyFrom(b, b.getAttribute("data-copy"), v);
    });
  });

  // QMS Health Check: prepares a summary the visitor emails. Nothing is sent from this page.
  var form = document.getElementById("hc-form");
  var result = document.getElementById("hc-result");
  var summary = document.getElementById("hc-summary");
  var mail = document.getElementById("hc-mail");

  function val(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ""; }
  function radio(name) { var el = form.querySelector('input[name="' + name + '"]:checked'); return el ? el.value : ""; }

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var lines = [
      "QMS HEALTH CHECK REQUEST",
      "",
      "Company: " + val("hc-company"),
      "Contact: " + val("hc-name"),
      "Email: " + val("hc-email"),
      "Phone: " + (val("hc-phone") || "Not given"),
      "Type of organisation: " + val("hc-type"),
      "Size: " + val("hc-size"),
      "Where they are today: " + val("hc-situation"),
      "Upcoming audit or deadline: " + (val("hc-audit") || "None given"),
      "",
      "Key processes documented: " + radio("q1"),
      "Documents and records controlled: " + radio("q2"),
      "Internal audit in last 12 months: " + radio("q3"),
      "Non-conformances and corrective actions followed up: " + radio("q4"),
      "",
      "Biggest quality challenge:",
      val("hc-challenge") || "Not given"
    ];
    var text = lines.join("\n");
    summary.value = text;
    var subject = "QMS Health Check request: " + val("hc-company");
    mail.setAttribute("href", "mailto:" + EMAIL + "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subject) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(text));
    result.hidden = false;
    form.hidden = true;
    result.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  });

  document.getElementById("hc-copy").addEventListener("click", function () {
    copyFrom(this, summary.value, summary);
  });
  document.getElementById("hc-edit").addEventListener("click", function () {
    result.hidden = true;
    form.hidden = false;
    form.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
